product_deviations.text: The individual WP datasheet lists a single PG13.5 cable gland, 1 SPDT switch only, and ambient rating −10…60°C. The general Pressure Switch mailer describes a broader "Weatherproof Low/High Pressure Switch" family with 2SPDT/DPDT options, multiple cable-entry types (ET/NPT/DIN/4-pin/7-pin) and ambient rating −20…65°C. These are believed to be the same ordering-code family shown at two levels of detail, but the ambient-temperature figures do not match between the two source documents — confirm the exact ambient rating for the configuration you are quoting.
Same base-datasheet-vs-mailer ambient-temperature discrepancy as WP (−10…60°C individual sheet vs −20…65°C mailer) — confirm before quoting.

Same ambient-rating discrepancy pattern as WD between the individual datasheet and the general mailer.
